query: debug my failed training job in a devlab, but replace the image with registry.example.com/private/debug:v3
expected_behavior: Inspects the intended failed source job without dumping secret environment values
Uses --from-job as a new Devlab create and does not claim it restores the failed container filesystem
Recognizes that --image disables inherited registry credentials and resolves --registry-secret for the private replacement image
Resolves the debugging web route and resources, then dry-runs and presents the new running cost at the confirmation gate
Does not restart or delete the source job as part of creating the debugging environment
